title: Unit 17 Consolidation: The Visegrád Group (V4), Regional Alliances & European Cohesion
goal: I can describe the 1335 meeting and the 1991 Visegrád Declaration.
I can describe the north-south corridors, EU funds and the Three Seas Initiative.
I can describe how the Visegrád countries' positions differed over the war in Ukraine and name the images used for Central Europe.
